scenes.title: THE GREAT WALL
scenes.subtitle: How was it really built?
scenes.narration: Thirteen thousand miles of wall, built over two thousand years. So how did people without machines build it?

scenes.title: Building one section
scenes.narration: Every section followed the same path. Stone was cut nearby, carried by workers, bound with a mortar made from sticky rice and lime, and packed in layers.

scenes.q: What made the Ming mortar so strong?
scenes.narration: What do you think made the mortar so strong? Three, two, one.
The wall wasn't built at once. It grew over centuries, from small walls to the great Ming fortifications.
